SK9011 A member's braces are split across a preprocessor branch

The member is emitted verbatim, because its brace structure depends on which branch is active.

CategoryTool
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeSyntax
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseyes
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since0.2

Why

Roslyn parses one branch and hands back a tree describing only that one. Reindenting from it moves braces the other branch owns.

Example

Instead of:

#if A
void M() {
#else
void M() {
#endif
}

When it does not fire

None known; the check counts braces per branch and only fires when the branches disagree.
